description: A simple to-do list with task filters, completion checkboxes, deletion and clear-completed. Your tasks are saved in your browser and are still there on your next visit.

faqs.a: Your tasks are stored in your browser's localStorage on this device only. Clearing site data or using a different browser or device will start a fresh list.
No — the tool works fully offline once the page has loaded. All data stays on your own device.
faqs.q: Do I need the internet to use it?

faqs.a: The filter buttons show All, Active or Done tasks so you can focus on what is left, while the counter always shows how many tasks are still active.
faqs.q: What do the All / Active / Done filters do?

howto: Type a task in the input box and click "Add" (or press Enter).
Tick the checkbox next to a task to mark it done.
Use the filter buttons to view All, Active or Done tasks.
Click "Clear completed" to remove all finished tasks at once.
title: To-Do List
